subject: [PATCH v2 2/6] NFSD: Apply per-export I/O modes to READ and WRITE

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch updates the NFSD code to apply per-export I/O modes to READ and WRITE operations. It resolves each export's effective I/O mode by checking explicit settings or using the global io_cache_read/write knob. The patch also removes unnecessary coupling between debugfs knobs, allowing for more flexible configuration of I/O behavior on a per-export basis. Additionally, it updates debugfs comments to match the new behavior and introduces a global 'never splice' override.
